en.All four loops are enabled by default. S: All four loops are enabled by default. Shared arcs use one native two-way road with one lane each way, connected to one-way ramps. Right turns remain when a loop is disabled.
en.Connects an east-west highway to a north: Connects an east-west highway to a north-south two-way road. Each of the four ramps can be disabled. Cross-road endpoints remain elevated.
en.Connects an east-west highway to a two-l: Connects an east-west highway to a two-lane branch on the south, with one loop ramp. Use the game's rotation controls to change the branch direction.
en.Connects an east-west mainline to a sout: Connects an east-west mainline to a southern branch. Every turn has a separate ramp; the two left turns cross at different levels.
en.A full four-way interchange with four le: A full four-way interchange with four left-turn ramps sweeping around the center. Its larger footprint suits highway junctions.
en.Two mainline levels and two left-turn ra: Two mainline levels and two left-turn ramp levels provide all twelve through and turning movements.

zh_CN.All four loops are enabled by default. S: 四叶默认全开。共用弧段使用一条原生双向道路，每向一条车道，两端连接单向匝道；关闭叶片后仍保留右转。
zh_CN.Connects an east-west highway to a north: 东西高速主路与南北双向道路相接，四条匝道可独立关闭。横向道路保留高架接头。
zh_CN.Connects an east-west highway to a two-l: 东西高速主路与南侧两车道支路相接，含一条环形匝道。使用游戏原生旋转操作调整支路朝向。
zh_CN.Connects an east-west mainline to a sout: 东西主路与南侧支路相接；所有转向使用独立匝道，两条左转分层跨越。
zh_CN.A full four-way interchange with four le: 四路全互通，四条左转匝道向外展开并绕中心旋转。占地较大，适合高速公路枢纽。
zh_CN.Two mainline levels and two left-turn ra: 两层直行主线与两层左转匝道，包含全部十二个直行和转向连接。
zh_CN.Shared interchange arc lane: 立交共用弧段单行车道
